main_text.p: tiua grauissimas. Primam sub Nerone, sub Domitiano secundam, tertiam sub Traiano, sub Antonino quartam, sub Seuero quintam, sextam sub Maximino, sub Decio septimam, octauam sub Valeriano, sub Aureliano nonam, decimam sub Diocletiano & Maximiano. Quibus durantibus, tanta Christianorum tur-ba passim passa est, vt nullus esset dies, testante Hieronymo in Epistola ad Chro-matium & Heliodorum, (si tamen illa sit Hieronymi,) cui non vltra quinque-mil-le Martyres reperiri possint ascripti, ex-cepto die Calendarum Ianuarij. Ita vt Pontifices Romani, triginta tres, à Pe-tro scilicet vsque ad Sylustrum, etiam ex Romanensium testimonio (licet ex his aliquos, Onuphrius in Platinā {d}Confessores, non Martyres) martyrium amplexi sunt. Revoluantur interim Historiae, consulantur Annales, si ex his, vel alibi per terrarum orbem è Christianis quispiam, quenquam ad seditionem interea sollicitauerit, aut impulerit ad internecionē praefectorum: cùm tamen nec multitudo ijs deesset, nec fortitudo, nec oportunitas, nec pru-Nimirum Anacletum, Pium, Eleutherium, Zepherynum Anterum, Dionysium Miltiadem.

page.notes: Printed line-end hyphens kept as printed: tur-ba, quinquemil-le, ex-cepto, Chro-matium, Pe-tro. The first line is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The marginal note is set in italic and is printed as "Zepherynum", kept as printed. The note mark is "d", and the note sits beside the first lines of the column. "Platinā" keeps its printed macron. The final word is broken at the line end as "pru-" and is left as printed.
